descricao: Meta-approved message templates to start conversations outside the 24h window.

form.nomeHint: Use snake_case: lowercase letters, numbers and _ only.
form.exemploHint: Meta requires one example per variable. Without it the template is rejected.
form.erroExemplo: Fill in an example for every variable in the body.

botoes.hint: Up to {{max}} buttons. Quick replies are shown before the others.
botoes.urlHint: For a different link per send, end the URL with {{1}}.
botoes.telefoneHint: With country code, digits only. E.g.: +5511999999999
botoes.codigoHint: The actual code is provided on each send.

erros.buttons_not_allowed: Authentication templates do not accept buttons.
erros.copy_code_not_allowed: Copy code is only allowed in marketing templates.
erros.too_many_buttons: A template accepts at most 10 buttons.
erros.too_many_of_type: A template accepts at most 2 links, 1 call and 1 copy code.
erros.text_too_long: Button text must be up to 25 characters.
erros.url_too_long: The URL must be up to 2000 characters.
erros.url_variable_position: The variable can only be {{1}}, at the end of the URL.
erros.phone_invalid: Invalid phone: use country code and digits only, up to 20 characters.
erros.code_too_long: The code must be up to 15 characters.

campanha.descricao: Each offered template shows up as a provider under Marketing → SMS campaign. Picking the provider is picking the template.
campanha.comoUsar: In the campaign text, enter only the variable values, in order — one per line or separated by semicolons. Use CRM fields so each contact gets their own value. E.g.: #LEAD.TITLE#;#LEAD.ID#
campanha.semVariaveis: No variables — leave the campaign text empty.
campanha.comVariaveis_one: {{count}} variable to provide in the campaign text.
campanha.comVariaveis_other: {{count}} variables to provide in the campaign text.
campanha.vazio: No approved template on this line yet.
campanha.registrado: Template available in your SMS campaigns.
campanha.indisponivel: Nothing changed: campaign sending is not available in this environment.
campanha.indisponivelAmbiente: Campaign sending is not available in this environment. Contact support.
campanha.erroLeitura: Could not read the templates for this line.
campanha.erroAcao: Could not change the provider for this template.
campanha.bloqueada: This line has no active subscription, so its templates cannot be offered in campaigns.
campanha.botaoDinamico: This template has a button that needs a value on each send (link or code), and the campaign cannot provide it.
